state: Preparation only; official C13 tuple, actual qualification packet and full capture manifests are not yet received.

official_identity.basis: Use only identities and original paths delivered by FVD and the sole UI evidence owner. No identity is inferred from a live writer or an earlier candidate.

coverage_plan.authoritative_required_ids: Each new full capture-only manifest's exact required_review_case_ids.
coverage_plan.baseline_requirement: Preserve the original full required-case recipes and scope. Their C13 PNGs, case JSON and evidence must all be fresh; old C11/C12 pixels or conclusions provide no current manual credit.
coverage_plan.new_selected_case_ids: Await the exact IDs and original paths supplied in the C13 packet and manifests; do not invent or reuse old candidate names as locators.
coverage_plan.ordinary_shortcut_requirement: All three ordinary SC shortcut identities must also be observed from fresh same-source frames in every full round.
coverage_plan.reference_requirement: Reconcile every required original reference to its owner-declared identity and actual viewing records. An exact reference and a related-contract comparison must remain distinguishable.

binding_contracts: Every C13 assignment cites the reusable worker contract and the C12 Root disposition addendum.
A source shortcut must expose a distinguishable token derived from the real source name with complete glyphs. Complete compact-name text is not required.

SC selected 700-weight 00, 01 and 02 tokens must be read completely from the actual new original PNGs. Metadata display_name, geometry, differing fragments or mechanical PASS cannot replace glyph visibility.
PW ordinary, selected and held-inverse boundaries remain within their already accepted contract; preserve readable identifying tokens, complete glyphs, frame, draft and existing caption.
A configured shortcut already provides visible selected identity. The independent caption supplies feedback for a hidden More scope; no new caption row is required for each visible shortcut.
Keep direct appearance, existing pointer/action/state support and native or physical capability claims separate. No new runtime or native claim follows from an opened desktop PNG.

dispatch.context: A new fork_turns=none worker for every small batch.
dispatch.coordinator_role: Maintain one unique current-case ownership map and aggregate the small original reports without opening the entire image collection.
dispatch.module_gate: Dispatch only after the sole owner declares a module immutable and its local original PNG, case, state, metadata, action, log and reference inventory complete. Reconcile every incremental identity with the final capture-only manifest.
dispatch.report_identity: Reference the immutable input/module inventory and freeze tuple once. Retain each current case's original PNG/case/state/metadata/action/log/reference SHA, actual-open flag and concrete observation. Use the compact schema without copying large shared inputs.
dispatch.reading_limit: If a required glyph is unreadable, retain a real reading pending and request a sole-owner provenance-bound original-scale crop. Do not generate a crop locally or count an unviewed crop as closure.

gates.qualification: Build a separate actual C13 qualification ledger only after official tuple and immutable current originals arrive. Zero unresolved new actionable issues and zero required reading pending are necessary for affected clearance.
gates.full_round_one: Full capture and exact current manual coverage must both complete, every incremental original identity must match the final manifest, historical closures must use current evidence, and new actionable/required pending must be zero.
gates.full_round_two: Begin only after complete round-one manual clearance and FVD resource release. Use the same new frozen source, binary, references, plan and tools, with fresh full capture and actual manual review.
gates.record_review: Root/FVD retain recording authority after manual and same-source external gates. The coordinator does not record a clean result from static preparation or a partial qualification.
